title: Senior Data Analyst
full_description: About Atlys Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely. Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers. Atlys is changing that. We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries . But we’re still early. The Role We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own critical business data end to end and help teams make better decisions with it. You’ll build the metrics, dashboards and analyses that become the single source of truth across the business, while partnering closely with teams to solve high-impact problems and uncover growth opportunities. This role is for someone who can independently navigate messy data, define the right questions, and turn analysis into clear decisions and action. The Job Own business data as a reliable source of truth by ensuring key metrics, reports and dashboards are accurate, consistent and trusted across teams. Build and evolve decision-making systems across business, marketing, finance and other core functions through dashboards, reporting and analytical frameworks. Turn complex datasets into actionable insights by writing advanced SQL, analysing large datasets, and identifying trends, anomalies and opportunities. Define the metrics that matter by partnering with teams to establish KPIs, improve measurement and create clarity around performance. Lead data-driven problem solving by independently structuring ambiguous business questions, diagnosing root causes and recommending actions that improve outcomes. The Ideal Candidate You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You Have 3-6 years of experience in data analytics, business analytics or a similar role, ideally in a fast-moving consumer or technology business. Are exceptionally strong in SQL and comfortable independently working with large, complex and imperfect datasets. Have strong experience with visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio or Metabase, and can build dashboards that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Bring strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate analysis into clear recommendations for stakeholders. Have exposure to Python or a strong understanding of how data flows through products and technology systems. What You Can Expect Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work. Here’s What You Can Expect Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create. Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us. A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off. Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together. Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft. Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible. Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software. An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator. Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront. Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

Use best practices for feature building and data transformation on complex health data from many sources, including diagnosis and procedure codes, lab results, pharmacy, and billing records. Be a mentor to peer data scientists and AI engineers, helping them learn new skills and advance in their careers. Infrastructure and Data Handling: Knowledge of data engineering techniques, such as ETL processes, big data solutions, and cloud-based platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and of handling sensitive health data securely. Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving: The skill of being able to break down difficult issues into manageable steps and plan experiments to test theories. Able to work with uncertainty and quickly come up with new ideas. Communication and teamwork: You should be able to communicate clearly both in writing and in person, and you should be able to turn complicated studies into insights that are useful for clinicians and the business. Leadership: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, get everyone on the same page, and get everyone to agree on something. Develop calibration and measurement-system analytics for calibration overdue risk, instrument drift, measurement uncertainty, compliance gaps, and quality impact from calibration failures. Use NLP and GenAI to extract insights from QCMS audit reports, CAPA narratives, consumer complaints, deviations, SOPs, HACCP/Food Safety Plans (FSP), maintenance logs, and supplier communications; enable AI-assisted quality investigations and audit preparation. Build analytics connecting supplier quality, incoming-material risk, and customer-quality outcomes to create end-to-end quality visibility across the supply chain — from raw material to consumer. Build quality dashboards, risk scorecards, alerts, and self-service analytics for Q&FS, BU Quality, Global Food Safety, Plant Operations, and RDQ stakeholders. Manufacturing Data Science — Core / Supporting Focus Build IIoT-enabled analytics using data from PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES , sensors, edge devices, vision systems, LIMS, and QMS platforms. Develop predictive-maintenance models for equipment failure, asset health, remaining useful life, condition-based monitoring, anomaly detection, and maintenance prioritisation — leveraging IL6S (Integrated Lean Six Sigma) loss-elimination methodology. Support automated process control and closed-loop control through process modelling, deviation prediction, setpoint recommendations, and feedback-driven control strategies. Apply statistical process control, process-capability analysis (CpK/PpK), design of experiments, and root-cause methods (8D, 5-Why, FMEA) to reduce variation and improve yield — in partnership with the Process Excellence and Supply Chain Excellence teams. Build mathematical optimisation and simulation models for production scheduling, line balancing, capacity planning, material flow, quality-resource allocation, sanitation scheduling, and calibration planning. Support Deployment & Industrialization of models to cloud, edge, or on-premise environments with monitoring, retraining, governance, and auditability. Platform, Data & Delivery Partner with Q&FS, BU Quality, Global Food Safety, RDQ, Manufacturing, Supply Chain Excellence, CS&L, Process Excellence, Engineering/Maintenance, Procurement, HSE, and MDS (Mondelēz Digital Services) teams to define high-impact use cases and measurable success criteria. Design, build, validate, deploy, and continuously improve ML, statistical, NLP, computer-vision, optimisation, simulation, and GenAI solutions using Databricks and Azure/AWS . Design and implement scalable, secure, and governed data architectures and data-science solution patterns on Azure/AWS in collaboration with the AI, Data & Analytics Platform team. Integrate data from SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, MES, SAP EWM, o9, IMS, QMS/eQMS (QCMS), food-safety systems, audit tools, and IIoT platforms into reliable Databricks-based data products — leveraging Collibra / Ataccama for data governance and MuleSoft / SAP BTP for integration. Build real-time dashboards, alerts, scorecards, and self-service analytics using Tableau, Power BI, Databricks SQL, or Python-based tools for Q&FS, plant, and ISC stakeholders — feeding into Executive dashboards and KPI reporting where applicable. Operationalise models through MLOps practices, including version control (GitHub/ADO), CI/CD, model monitoring, drift detection, retraining, governance, security, and auditability. Quantify business impact through MDLZ-specific quality, food-safety, manufacturing, and supply-chain KPIs. Hands-on, production-level experience with Databricks and Strong cloud experience (Azure and/or AWS) is required, particularly across data engineering, data-science solutioning, and solution architecture. Strong Python skills, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, time-series libraries, and TensorFlow or PyTorch. Strong SQL, PySpark, and experience building scalable data pipelines and governed data products in Databricks. Strong foundation in machine learning, statistics, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, classification, regression, forecasting, and model validation. Experience designing end-to-end data-science and data-engineering architectures on cloud, including ingestion, storage, processing, feature engineering, model training, deployment, monitoring, and governance. Experience building dashboards using Tableau, Power BI, Grafana, Databricks SQL, or Python-based tools. Experience working with QMS/eQMS, IMS, MES, SAP ERP, CMMS, historians, IIoT platforms, or audit-management systems. Strong stakeholder-management, communication, and data-storytelling skills — comfortable presenting to both plant-floor teams and senior ISC leadership. Good to Have Knowledge of quality and food-safety frameworks such as HACCP, GMP, PRPs, Hygienic Zoning, allergen control, environmental monitoring, sanitation controls, and CAPA — familiarity with MDLZ Quality Policies (QPs) is a plus. Knowledge of Manufacturing & Domain Frameworks such as Industry 4.0, IoT telemetry, Data Vault 2.0, and statistical process control (SPC) is a plus. Experience with NLP techniques such as text classification, named-entity recognition, topic modelling, embeddings, semantic search, and retrieval-augmented generation. Experience with computer vision, image processing, object detection, segmentation, and defect classification in manufacturing or food-production environments. Experience deploying GenAI solutions using LLMs, vector databases, prompt engineering, and responsible-AI guardrails. IL6S / Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt. HACCP, PCQI, FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, or BRCGS certification is advantageous. Reduced consumer complaints, non-conformances, quality escapes, and quality-related holds. Reduced food-safety risks through sanitation, pathogen-monitoring, hygienic zoning, and environmental-monitoring analytics. Manufacturing Reduced RM/PM Yield Loss (%) — raw material and packaging material losses against zero-base cost. Improved OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), throughput, and schedule adherence. Reduced unplanned downtime, maintenance cost, and calibration-related disruptions. Improved first-pass yield, CpK/PpK (process capability), and product-quality consistency. Supply Chain Improved CSL (Customer Service Level), Supply Reliability, and Demand Supportability. Improved SFA (Statistical Forecast Accuracy) and reduced forecast bias where analytics support demand-sensing. Improved inventory turns, safety-stock optimisation, and supplier-quality performance. Reduced COGS impact through optimised production scheduling and capacity utilisation. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality. Our Mission Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers. Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company. Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/ About Valmo And The Data Science Team Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models. About The Role As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile. What You Will Do Own a workstream end to end: decide which problems are worth solving, set and drive its roadmap, and be accountable for the movement of its metrics. Formulate complex, loosely defined business problems in network design, routing, scheduling, allocation and capacity planning as LP, MILP, MINLP or constraint programming models, with explicit assumptions. Solve them at scale with decomposition (Benders, Lagrangian relaxation, column generation, branch-and-price), heuristics and metaheuristics (large neighbourhood search, ALNS, tabu search) and constraint programming, within real planning-time budgets. Handle uncertainty with stochastic, robust and chance-constrained optimisation, and test decisions through simulation before they reach the ground. Combine OR with ML and DL, such as demand and volume forecasting, ETA prediction and learned heuristics, wherever it improves the decision. Write production-grade code and work with engineering to ship solvers and models into systems that run every day, with testing, monitoring and reproducible pipelines. Use AI coding agents as part of how you build, and verify the formulations, code and results they produce. Mentor DS1s and DS2s on formulation, modelling craft and code quality; align the roadmap with product, engineering, operations and business; and explain trade-offs to senior leaders in decision terms. Publish your work at A* conferences and journals, as part of a team with a highly innovative work culture. What You Will Need Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field. 5–8 years of experience (or 3+ years with a PhD) applying operations research to real-world problems, with optimisation models deployed in production. Deep expertise in mathematical optimisation (LP, MILP, network flows, integer and combinatorial optimisation), with a proven ability to formulate ambiguous problems, design heuristics, and break complex problems into simpler sub-problems. Experience with large-scale solution methods (decomposition, column generation, heuristics and metaheuristics, constraint programming) and with optimisation under uncertainty and simulation. Hands-on experience with solvers and modelling tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools (including CP-SAT), HiGHS, Pyomo or PuLP. Strong programming: expert Python and SQL, PySpark or similar for large datasets, and solid software engineering (object-oriented design, Git, testing, code review). Fluency with AI coding agents, with the judgement to check their output. Working knowledge of ML and DL (forecasting, regression, tree-based models, neural networks) and of how to combine them with optimisation. Experience leading a workstream and mentoring junior data scientists, and the ability to explain trade-offs and limitations to senior business and operations leaders. Good To Have Domain experience in logistics, e-commerce, transportation or supply chain: network design, line haul, vehicle routing (including time windows) or last-mile delivery. Experience with deep learning based forecasting, learning-augmented optimisation (ML for combinatorial optimisation, reinforcement learning) or GPU-accelerated optimisation. Performance-critical programming in C++, Java or Julia, and familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud. Publications at OR/ML venues (e.g. INFORMS, Transportation Science, Operations Research, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD) or open-source contributions.

title: Senior Data Analyst, Shared Services, Credit Operations
full_description: Senior Data Analyst, Shared Services, Credit Operations About the Role: Morningstar DBRS Structured Finance team is looking for candidates who will play the role of Senior Data Analyst within the Structured Finance group. Ideal candidates will have strong logical reasoning, operational and administrative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks. In this role, you will support global teams by uploading and downloading documents, extracting information from reports, including financial data input, conducting background research, maintaining document retention, supporting regulatory reporting, and performing quality control checks. You will also assist with processes related to pre- and post-rating committees. With experience, you will be expected to develop a thorough understanding of Structured Finance transactions, including primary deal documents and trustee reports, as well as the basics of the credit rating process. This position is based in out of Navi Mumbai. Responsibilities Extract data from trustee reports using a pre-defined format and become familiar with SF-related terminology Provide support to global analysts on pre and post Rating Committee activities Conduct and ensure Conflicts of Interest Checks are completed prior to Rating Committee Assist the onshore team with document retention, regulatory reporting and quality control Establish rating committees requested by FA(s) including executing any necessary conflict checks Create and prepare materials for both internal and external meetings that maintain company standards and values Own ancillary tasks including administrative and streamlining of the ratings workflow Interaction with global stakeholders on timely basis & understanding their requirements Have a mindset to bring about process efficiencies and ideate automations Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Economics, Finance or Management Studies 2-4 years of relevant Financial Data experience, experience at a rating agency is a plus Excellent communication and co-ordination skills and should be able to manage administrative tasks efficiently Proficient in computer applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and related tools. Strong attention to detail and accuracy Highly motivated, self-starter who is keen to learn, has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic Ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and deliver results in a timely manner Good interpersonal skills and ability to participate/ contribute as a team player Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer. Hybrid model – partial work from home option where employee will from Morningstar’s Navi Mumbai offices 4 days a week (subject to change as per organizational directive). About Us Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world. Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech-forward approach, and exceptional customer service. Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings. If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker. Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues. R11_DBRSRatingsGmbHIndia DBRS Ratings GmbH, Branch India Legal Entity

full_description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. Job Description Technical Product Manager – Lilly USA Data Analytics & AI (DA&AI) At Lilly, we believe in the talent of our workforce. One of the best ways to utilize and develop that talent is to use our existing workforce to fill new and/or open positions. If you are looking for a new position within Lilly, you can view and apply to open roles posted in the internal job posting system. You must meet the minimum qualifications outlined in the job description and have or obtain work authorization in the country where the position is to be considered. When applying internally, your current supervisor will receive notification that you have applied. We encourage employees to discuss the opportunity with their supervisor before applying. Path/Level P3 Job Title Technical Product Manager, Lilly USA Tech@Lilly – DA&AI Job Function Information Technology Location India – Bangalore Reports to Director, CTI Commercial India, Tech@Lilly Note: Roles are posted at the lowest level of a band. Employees hired into banded positions transfer at their current level, despite the level indicated in the posting. Role Overview The Technical Product Manager (TPM) owns the product vision, roadmap, prioritization and value realization for Lilly USA Commercial Sales data and analytics products. The role translates the needs of Sales Operations, field leadership and commercial teams into trusted, reusable data products and analytical capabilities that improve field effectiveness, customer engagement and business decision-making. This individual-contributor role combines strong Commercial Sales stakeholder partnership with formal product management accountability. It moves beyond demand intake and status coordination to owning product outcomes, roadmap decisions, prioritization, adoption and measurable business value. The TPM owns the Sales vertical product direction and business outcomes while partnering with platform Product Owners, Data Architects, Business Analysts, Scrum Masters, engineering, quality and compliance teams that retain accountability for their respective platform, architecture and delivery responsibilities. Key Responsibilities Product vision, strategy and roadmap Define and communicate a multi-quarter data-product vision and roadmap for Commercial Sales, aligned with Commercial Unit priorities and the broader Data & AI strategy. Translate business problems such as field effectiveness, targeting and customer engagement into validated product opportunities, data requirements and measurable outcomes. Prioritize the roadmap and backlog using business value, urgency, strategic alignment, effort, risk, compliance, capacity and dependency trade-offs; make and defend scope decisions with leadership. Maintain a transparent roadmap, release outlook and product lifecycle plan, clearly communicating changes in priorities, capacity, funding or dependencies. Align the Sales roadmap with reusable enterprise capabilities, platform roadmaps and relevant AI innovation initiatives before approving vertical-specific development. Product discovery and data-product definition Lead structured discovery with field users, Sales Operations, reporting teams to understand decisions, workflows, unmet needs and pain points before defining solutions. Validate problems and proposed product concepts through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, data analysis, usability testing and field feedback. Define the business contract for each Sales data product, including intended consumers, decision use cases, product grain, key identifiers, business definitions, source systems, refresh expectations, quality thresholds, access requirements and service expectations, in partnership with the Business Analyst and Data Architect. Maintain a clear product catalogue covering product purpose, business owner, product owner, consumers, lifecycle status, dependencies, service expectations and adoption measures. End-to-end product delivery and acceptance Own product outcomes from validated opportunity through production adoption, including scope, prioritization, release decisions, enablement and post-launch value tracking. Own product priorities, backlog ordering and timely scope decisions; partner with the Business Analyst to translate outcomes into epics, features, user stories, data requirements and acceptance criteria. Partner with the Scrum Master so planning refinement, reviews and delivery ceremonies support product priorities and timely decisions. Work with data engineers, analysts, ML engineers, quality teams and architects to resolve product questions and make informed value, usability, risk and sequencing trade-offs. Establish business acceptance criteria, coordinate UAT with authorized Sales stakeholders and secure business sign-off before release. Ensure critical Sales measures are reconciled across source systems, data products and consuming reports before production adoption. Coordinate product acceptance and operational handover to downstream analytics and reporting teams, including documentation, access, support ownership and known limitations. Track delivery and product health, proactively surfacing risks, dependencies, quality concerns, cost considerations and mitigation decisions. Stakeholder, portfolio and operating-model leadership Act as the single point of accountability and voice of the product for Commercial business partners, Sales Operations, field leadership and technology stakeholders. Lead regular Sales product reviews covering roadmap, value realized, adoption, product health, dependencies, risks and decisions required. Lead quarterly demand, capacity and sequencing discussions for the Sales data-product portfolio, balancing business value, urgency, strategic alignment, risk, technical dependencies and available delivery capacity. Assess existing enterprise data products, approved patterns and reusable platform capabilities before starting new development. Contribute to maintaining the Sales DA&AI operating model, decision rights and RACI, recommending updates when product, platform or delivery accountabilities change. Provide concise executive updates and evidence-based investment recommendations, including the consequences of funding, capacity and sequencing decisions. Data, AI and regulated-environment stewardship Champion and apply architecture, data-governance, privacy, security, quality and compliance standards established by the accountable enterprise teams. Promote trusted business definitions, data quality, lineage, appropriate access and a consistent source of truth for Sales and Commercial measures. Identify and validate Sales problems that may benefit from analytics, machine learning, generative AI or agentic capabilities. Partner with Business Analysts and engineering teams to assess feasibility, data readiness, responsible-AI considerations and measurable business value. Support the transition of successful proofs of concept into governed, supportable and adoptable Sales products. Value realization, adoption and lifecycle management Define success measures before investment and track outcomes after release, using appropriate business, product, data-quality, adoption and delivery measures. Drive change management, training, communications and field enablement so intended users adopt and benefit from the products. Continuously improve products through evidence-based releases, address low adoption or quality concerns and retire low-value or duplicative capabilities. Role Accountability and Decision Rights The TPM is accountable for why the product is needed, whom it serves, what outcomes it must deliver, what is prioritized and whether value is realized. The TPM partners with the Business Analyst on detailed requirements, the Scrum Master on delivery ceremonies, the Data Architect on architecture and governance standards, engineering and quality teams on implementation and validation, and platform Product Owners on reusable capabilities and technical roadmaps. Qualifications and Skills Required Relevant experience in technology, data, analytics or digital product delivery, including substantial experience owning data, analytics or AI products in complex enterprise environments. Proven record of owning product discovery, vision, roadmap, prioritization, delivery, adoption and lifecycle management in an Agile environment such as Scrum or SAFe. Experience working with Commercial Sales, Sales Operations, CRM, field-force or customer-engagement data and platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva or similar. Strong data literacy, including the ability to interpret data models, SQL outputs, dashboards, business measures, quality indicators and analytical results. Working knowledge of modern cloud data and analytics platforms, such as Databricks and AWS, including Lakehouse concepts, data pipelines, data modelling, semantic layers, business intelligence and ML/AI product lifecycles. The role is not expected to be a hands-on data engineer but must engage credibly with technical teams and make informed product trade-offs. Experience with product discovery, outcome-based roadmaps, business acceptance, UAT, product adoption and measurable product KPIs. Experience managing priorities, dependencies, capacity and sequencing across multiple business and delivery teams. Working knowledge of Jira or Azure DevOps for product backlog and roadmap management. Demonstrated understanding of data governance, privacy, security, quality, compliance and responsible AI in a regulated environment. Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, negotiation and consulting skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and global cross-time-zone teams without formal authority. Preferred Pharma, life sciences or healthcare Commercial experience across brand, sales operations, market access, marketing analytics or omnichannel engagement. Experience with AI/ML or generative-AI product use cases such as next-best action, forecasting, recommendation or copilots for Sales users. Experience handing data products over to downstream analytics, reporting or decision-support platforms. Familiarity with tools and services such as Confluence, Databricks, AWS, Power BI, Tableau, Redshift or Amazon S3. One of the Product, Agile certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP would be advantage. Leadership Behaviors Creates urgency and momentum while making thoughtful product trade-offs. Influences without authority across multiple levels and functions. Communicates clearly, listens actively and builds trusted stakeholder relationships. Works constructively through ambiguity and keeps teams focused on outcomes and decisions. Uses analytical and critical thinking to identify product, data and delivery gaps. Balances customer advocacy with enterprise reuse, governance, quality and long-term product sustainability.
